name: ThinkingMap
description: One session of thinking. Holds the user's original unstructured idea verbatim and tracks which stage of the loop the session has reached. Everything else hangs off this root, so a saved map can be reopened and continued later.

name: Message
description: One turn of the conversation, in order. The conversation panel on the left of every screen renders these. Paired with MapNode: the two are different views of the same thinking process.

name: MapNode
description: One node in the visual map. A tree via nullable parentId, so no separate edge table is needed. 'kind' says what the node represents (idea, problem, assumption, open-question, research, finding, gap, approach, pro, risk, known, unknown, direction, next-step) and 'status' drives the dashed / solid / highlighted treatment from the mockups. Self-referencing, so parents must precede children in seed input order.

name: AnthropicMessagesAPI
description: The single external dependency: POST https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages on claude-opus-5. It drives the whole loop — deconstructing the idea into questions, emitting map updates as tool calls, and writing the final plan. The Research phase needs no separate search provider: Anthropic's server-side web_search tool runs inside this same call, so its findings arrive as content blocks in the response. Mocked per scenario via mocks.http, which is why every screen renders without credentials.
